Roadmap & goals

What we have shipped. What comes next.

A focused Dart roadmap: reusable core, PostgreSQL, MySQL and OpenAI. Next priorities are ordered; future proposals require scope and API design before work begins.

6 delivered · 0 in progress · 2 planned · 1 awaiting input · 4 proposed.

Roadmap updated 9 October 2026. No upcoming milestone is currently being implemented. Publication is complete; production acceptance remains a separate gate.

Delivered = implemented and verified within documented scope. Planned = next priority, not started. Awaiting input = blocked on an external prerequisite. Proposed = an idea to assess, without a committed release or date. In progress is reserved for work that has actually started.

Next priorities

Acceptance

Production database acceptance

Production CA chains, failover, network partitions and longer load/soak checks remain unverified.

Prerequisite: A reproducible database version matrix and isolated TLS/failover test environments.

Done when: Record PostgreSQL and MySQL CA verification, interrupted transactions, failover, network partitions and soak results, including cleanup and rollback outcomes.

Read the details
Planned
Acceptance

Broader OpenAI live acceptance

Other API endpoints, live browser transport, load/soak and failure injection remain unverified. ChatGPT plan access covers only eligible Responses requests.

Prerequisite: An API-enabled test account and a server-side credential are required; ChatGPT subscription access is not general API coverage.

Done when: Record successful and failed live requests for supported endpoints, browser transport through a safe test backend, cancellation and bounded load/soak; retain endpoint-specific evidence.

Read the details

Examples

Runnable API and Flutter integration guides

Done when: Run the API example and Flutter lifecycle journey, including owner shutdown and interruption; publish commands and platform-specific results.

Future proposals

Core

Typed configuration, schemas and cache lifetimes

Explore structured schema issues, encode/decode round trips, configuration loading and scoped cache expiry.

Prerequisite: Agree on a small Dart-native API and lifecycle contracts before implementation.

Done when: Independent issue/round-trip tests, deterministic expiry tests and documented error/resource behavior.

Core

Broader streams and coordination primitives

Consider queue strategies, graceful end, replay PubSub, stream merging/grouping/time operators and Sink leftovers.

Prerequisite: Prioritize operators from actual application needs and define backpressure and cancellation contracts.

Done when: Independent bounded-buffer, early-exit, interruption and exactly-once cleanup scenarios for each advertised operator.

Proposed
Observability

Optional metrics and tracing adapters

Expose useful service and fiber observations without adding runtime dependencies to core.

Prerequisite: Select Dart observability interfaces and decide privacy, overhead and exporter boundaries.

Done when: Verify successful/failed/interrupted spans, scoped exporter cleanup and measured overhead.

Platform

Flutter and isolate integration helpers

Explore Flutter owner lifetimes and explicit isolate sendability helpers outside the portable core.

Prerequisite: Define ownership and supported platform contracts; choose real device acceptance targets.

Done when: Run native Flutter disposal journeys and isolate sendability/error propagation tests; record unsupported platforms.

No goals match this status. Choose another status to see delivered work and upcoming milestones.
New integrations are selected for real Dart application needs and established pub.dev drivers. RPC, workflows, cluster, CLI and the full Node package inventory are outside the current plan. Realtime AI and automatic tool execution need separate design and authorization before entering the roadmap.

Statuses are versioned editorial records, not a live activity feed. Update the shared roadmap data and README together with each milestone; record acceptance evidence before marking it delivered.
